reply: {"action":"send_email","to":"professor@fisk.edu","subject":"Summary: Fisk University Solar Array Completion","body":"Fisk University has completed a 1.4‑MW solar array on three campus rooftops and a parking structure, a project that took 14 months and was funded by state energy grants and a donor‑backed sustainability fund.
